newsitem.title: USA: National Patent to buy control of General Physics.
newsitem.headline: National Patent to buy control of General Physics.

text.p: National Patent Development Corp. said Wednesday it agreed to acquire the shares of General Physics Corp. that it does not already own for $26 million.
Under the deal, National Patent will acquire the remaining 5,039,732 shares, or 48 percent of the outstanding shares of General Physics, which does engineering work for utilities companies.
National Patent said it would issue 0.5299 share of its common stock for each outstanding share of General Physics common stock not already owned by National Patent.
The exchange ratio would lead to a price of $5.10 for each outstanding share of General Physics, the company said.
The transaction must be approved by the boards of directors of each company, and a definitive agreement must still be reached, National Patent said.

General Physics provides engineering, environmental, training, analytical and technical support services to commercial nuclear and fossil power utilities and to the federal Defence and Energy agencies.
